transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and the controls for the equipment-issue desk and the protected medical-records desk, I need to hear from facilities and signal. Please report any room requirements, infrastructure concerns, or anything else I need to know before we open either desk tomorrow morning. Let's start with facilities — what do you need in the East and West rooms?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a floor-load concern before we assign rooms. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified the floor-load ratings this morning: East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That means the equipment-issue desk with its stocked cabinet cannot safely go in East Room — it would exceed the rating by 300 kilograms. West Room can handle it. I should note this hasn't been added to the relocation worksheet yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a network infrastructure requirement for the protected medical-records desk. That desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in the East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow morning — I received the confirmation this morning. However, this booking has not yet been added to the annex opening checklist, so it may not be visible to everyone here.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both. Let me make sure I have this straight before I sign off. Maj. Alvarez, the equipment-issue desk with its stocked 1,100 kg cabinet must go in West Room — East Room is only rated for 800 kg and can't safely support it. Lt. Okafor, the protected medical-records desk requires the fiber patch panel that's only in East Room, and your technician is booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow morning. So the logical assignment is: equipment-issue desk in West Room, medical-records desk in East Room. That satisfies both the floor-load constraint and the network infrastructure requirement. I also need both of you to get your updates onto the appropriate checklists — Maj. Alvarez, the floor-load information needs to go on the relocation worksheet, and Lt. Okafor, the 0900–1000 certification booking needs to go on the annex opening checklist. Once those are documented, I'll sign the approval. Are there any other requirements or concerns I need to know about before I finalize this?
